items.description: CLAUDE.md documents `make check` as the test command. The Makefile declares only `test` and `lint` — there is no check target, so the documented command fails outright.

CLAUDE.md states settings live in `app/settings.py` and that environment overrides are read there and nowhere else. The file is `app/config/settings.py`; no app/settings.py exists. A load-bearing path claim, not an example.

CLAUDE.md claims Django 4.2 with DRF serializers. pyproject.toml depends on fastapi and pydantic with no Django or DRF entry, and app/main.py builds a FastAPI app. Both the framework and the serializer layer claims are contradicted.

The deprecated single-file .cursorrules coexists with .cursor/rules/python.mdc, and the two carry the same three rules. Two sources of truth for one rule set, one of them in a format Cursor has replaced.

applyTo matches services/**/*.py and the repo has no services/ directory, so the rule can never attach to anything. The code it describes — a single `handle` entry point per module — matches nothing in app/ either.
